subject: Onsite roundtable: sequencing, backup slide owners & pre-read handoff
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine@veridian.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff: Veridian roundtable sequencing + pre-read owners

Hi team,

Quick kickoff for the Veridian onsite roundtable (June 2) — Elaine asked for a short, tightly sequenced half-day with one deep discussion slot and two lightning demos. The ask from Veridian is: clear ownership of slides and a single pre-read packet they can distribute internally.

Can we:
- Confirm primary presenter for the opening (10m) and who owns the deeper 45m technical demo?
- Identify a backup slide owner for each section (in case of last-minute travel hiccups)
- Agree on the pre-read bundle contents and who will assemble the PDF export by 5/20

Initial suggestions: open: Marissa (context + outcomes), deep demo: Karthik (runtime + cost/latency tradeoffs), backup: Jonas. Pre-read: executive summary + proposed runbook + 2 short case studies + a 1-page latency/cost appendix.

I can pull the pre-read doc together if someone can drop their slide stubs into the Drive folder (link below) by EOD 5/18.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-veridian-prework

Thanks,
Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine@veridian.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Veridian roundtable sequencing + pre-read owners

Jonas — thanks, +1 on the structure. A couple of specifics:

- I can cover opening context and outcomes (10m) and will draft the 1-page exec summary for the pre-read.
- Karthik is good for the deep demo; Karthik, can you confirm you'll target a 30–45m live demo with a short Q&A?
- Laura, can you be backup slide owner for the deep demo? If Karthik needs to hand off, Laura can present the demo notes and have the technical appendix ready.

Attachments: roundtable-agenda-prop-v2.pptx (slides + proposed timing)

I suggest we make the pre-read one PDF: 1) exec summary (Marissa), 2) runbook (Jonas), 3) demo brief + appendix (Karthik/Laura), 4) logistics note (Laura). Target: consolidated PDF by 5/20 so Elaine can circulate.

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Elaine Park <elaine@veridian.com>
Date: 2026-05-11T15:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Veridian roundtable sequencing + pre-read owners

Marissa / Jonas — confirmed.

I'll do a 35-minute demo focused on: model routing, fallbacks, and the latency vs cost knobs we want Veridian to evaluate. I will prepare:
- A 2-slide demo brief for the pre-read (what we'll show, runbook steps)
- A short appendix with numbers (expected 95th/median latencies for their projected QPS)

Laura — thanks for offering to be backup. I'll put my slide stubs in the Drive folder tonight.

Attachments: veridian-demo-appendix.xlsx (data snapshot)

Karthik

Subject: Re: Kickoff: Veridian roundtable sequencing + pre-read owners

Thanks, team — this looks great. A few quick notes from our side:

- Confirmed: half-day with a focused 45m technical deep dive and two 10–15m case/lightning segments.
- Pre-read PDF is perfect; our executive team expects a single doc they can forward to stakeholders. If you can get the consolidated PDF to me by EOD 5/20 that gives us time to route internally.
- Logistics: we'll need the final slide deck by 5/28 so our onsite AV team can package it.

Procurement (cc'd): we'll need a one-page statement of deliverables for the SOW — draft would be helpful but we can follow with a separate thread.

Appreciate the quick cadence. See you in June.

Best,
Elaine
